items.exampleEn: Fixing the old car turned out to be costly.
items.exampleZh: 修那台舊車結果花了很多錢。

items.exampleEn: Online retailers have taken many customers from small shops.
items.exampleZh: 網路零售商從小商店搶走了很多顧客。

items.exampleEn: The toll on this road goes up during holidays.
items.exampleZh: 這條路的通行費在假日期間會調漲。

items.exampleEn: The cafe gives its regular patrons a free drink on their birthday.
items.exampleZh: 這家咖啡店會在常客生日時送一杯免費飲料。

items.exampleEn: The seller agreed to lower the price a little.
These shoes are stylish and affordable.
All merchandise on this shelf is twenty percent off.
items.exampleZh: 這個架上的所有商品都打八折。

items.exampleEn: The program helps needy students pay for their books.
items.exampleZh: 這個計畫幫助清寒學生支付書錢。

items.sentenceEn: This retailer sells affordable clothes for the whole family.
items.sentenceZh: 這家零售商販售全家都買得起的衣服。

items.audioEn: Returning the merchandise by mail can be costly, so please bring it to our store.
items.audioZh: 用郵寄退貨可能會很貴，所以請把商品帶到我們店裡。

items.sentenceEn: Our loyal patrons get an extra discount every Friday.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的忠實顧客每週五可以享有額外折扣。

items.sentenceEn: Part of every sale goes to needy children in the area.
items.sentenceZh: 每筆銷售都有一部分捐給本地需要幫助的孩子。

items.stemEn: That hotel is too ____ for us; let's find something cheaper.
items.stemZh: 那家飯店對我們來說太貴了；我們找便宜一點的吧。

items.stemEn: Drivers must pay a ____ to use this highway.
items.stemZh: 駕駛人必須付通行費才能使用這條公路。

items.passageEn: Amy runs a small online shop that sells bags she makes by hand. She can't compete with big retailers on price, but her merchandise is unique and still affordable. Her shop has many loyal patrons, and some of them have bought more than ten bags. Recently, a large retailer offered to sell her bags in its stores. It sounded exciting, but the deal would be costly for her: the retailer wanted half of every sale. Amy decided to stay a small seller. "I would rather know my customers," she says. Every December, she gives part of her profits to needy families in her town.
items.passageZh: Amy 經營一家賣手工包的小網店。她在價格上無法和大型零售商競爭，但她的商品很獨特，價格也還算平價。她的店有許多忠實顧客，有些人已經買了十個以上的包包。最近，一家大型零售商提議在它的門市販售她的包包。聽起來很令人興奮，但這筆交易對她來說代價很高：那家零售商要拿走每筆銷售的一半。Amy 決定繼續當個小賣家。她說：「我寧願認識我的顧客。」每年十二月，她會把部分利潤捐給鎮上的貧困家庭。

questions.questionZh: Amy 為什麼不和大型零售商合作？
options: 對方的門市離她家太遠
對方要拿走每筆銷售的一半

questions.questionZh: Amy 每年十二月會做什麼？
options: 把部分利潤捐給貧困家庭
替忠實顧客舉辦年底打折活動

items.promptZh: 這家店的東西品質好又平價。
referenceEn: The products in this shop are of good quality and affordable.
This store's products are well made and affordable.
rubricZh: affordable 當形容詞，可放 be 動詞後（例如 are affordable）或名詞前（例如 affordable products）
「東西」可寫 things、products、goods 等；「品質好」可寫 of good quality、well made 等

items.instructionZh: 用 seller 造一個句子，說說你買東西時和賣家之間發生的事。
referenceEn: The seller gave me a free bag because I bought three shirts.
I asked the seller for a discount, and she said yes.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 seller（例如 the seller、an online seller）
句子要說到你和賣家之間的互動，時態合理即可
